_help: Categories for the Screen Time Widget. Apps match by .exe name (Task Manager > Details tab shows it). Sites match by domain, and subdomains count too (youtube.com also matches m.youtube.com). Add a path to match only part of a site (play.google.com/console = Play Console, not the Play Store). idle_secs = stop counting after this many seconds with no keyboard/mouse input. count_while_video_plays = keep counting while a video plays, even with no input. goal = more/less: colours trend arrows (green when moving the right way). Anything not listed goes to 'other'. The widget reloads this file a few seconds after you save it.
